body.statement: When \(K=1\) and the eligible set contains one target block, \(c_{0q}\) and \(\Omega_{00}\) reduce to the Choi--Yuan Proposition A.4 influence coefficients and their heteroskedastic scalar influence variance, while \(\widehat\Omega_{00}\) and \(\mathcal C_{n,0}\) reduce to the Choi--Kwon--Liao-style unit-residual plug-in variance and the ordinary studentized scalar interval.
body.justification: The required reduction rules out an event-time construction that changes the published scalar target or coefficients.
body.gap: This is a fidelity check against Choi--Yuan rather than an independent novelty claim.
body.consumer: Existing scalar implementations obtain the new procedure by setting the horizon set to one element.
